applicabilityBasis.summary: LVUSD is a protocol-internal synthetic unit for leveraged-perpetual position denomination and settlement. LeverUp mints it when traders post USDC and settles trading profit/loss in LVUSD. Redemption is conditional on depeg triggers, daily quotas and the prevailing reserve/supply ratio, rather than an issuer obligation for fixed monetary value. No general merchant-payment product or legal fiat-redemption obligor is identified. The non-payment-token category describes this niche trading unit within the tracker, not an assertion that every form of settlement lies outside the statutory definition.

genius.notes: LVUSD is assessed independently from underlying USDC and the separate MON/LVMON trading pool. USDC reserve composition does not confer Circle's authorization on LVUSD. The protocol documentation permits socialized losses, LV auctions, reserve/supply-ratio redemptions and yield deployment of surplus USDC; it does not publish a legal promise to redeem every LVUSD for one dollar. Terms exclude U.S. persons and U.S.-IP perpetual-contract access, state LeverUp is not registered with any financial authority, and do not identify a legal token-issuer entity. No legal issuerEntity, regulator, domicile, independent monthly reserve-attestation claim or authorization pathway is inferred.
